- Call the number on the back of your debit card or on your statement and ask:

- If your bank has an automated phone banking system or ATM, you can check the checking‑account balance there as well.

Once support links that checking account to your online profile, I’ll be able to see it here and can then help you check balances and recent transactions on it anytime.</action>
